history.note: Prospective horizon kernel with aligned match-age statistics. Standalone source SHA256 b72c47b6269ac6be7804135e2a39f4e3d1534983c5a25b9a713b376d0312dd23. Eight additional zero-initialized parameters; expected total 17133355, embedding 17078688, dense 54667, pending host measurement. Same parent random draws, 24 evidence coordinates and MLP dimensions; only the eight decayed-match coordinates change. Host-only scratch training under frozen protocol; no new performance measured in this phase. Canonical config SHA256 7c0b72895753efa76d7495186f74a44c59a1e3c099ccbeb13df4f30f7a7a5da3 (sorted compact JSON). Local verification: runtime study schema, allowed evidence IDs, protocol, exact 2x2 grid, literal CONFIG, numeric imports, no I/O, standalone syntax and identical ASTs except CONFIG passed. Inherited pair/context/scorer ASTs and constructor prefix through output creation match the committed ancestor. Diagnostics contain 45 scalars. Independent scalar formulas passed 600 randomized cases with analytic/finite-difference derivative checks, plus missing/empty/padded histories, mass bounds, permutation, singleton/all-match degeneracies and extreme theta. A constructed pair with equal counts and fixed-day mass separates horizon shape from amplitude; swapping match-age association changes aligned but leaves factorized mass fixed. These are mathematical/source checks, not Torch execution or measured gradient/performance results. Reproduce syntax with python3 -c "import ast,pathlib; ast.parse(pathlib.Path('candidate.py').read_text())". Host reproduction: load this standalone Model(meta, exact registered config), frozen protocol 9c1635366a72f4c4f67708ee7ae9b72a1b90197ffed3485736388ceff7c91d3e, scratch seeds and 3 epochs/batch4096/Adam-lr.001; accepted proposals execute automatically, with no public local training CLI. No local training, installation, test feedback or new performance claim. Preserve incumbent until host comparison. Agent-memory provenance: proposal records the new scene-scoped hypothesis/revision; host owns append-only trial receipts and prior records remain unchanged. Only model modules and proposal.json are editable; no separate memory or human-owned material was written. Agent/paper temporal searches returned no additional registered match; DIN primary text and DMR README were read, and five industry cards were considered without transferring their performance claims. Global novelty is unverified.

reference_format: Use allowed_observation_ids verbatim for local evidence. Descriptive references are accepted when they contain a complete known ID. Correct any previous_runtime_error before submitting; its failed costs remain charged.
action: Read candidate.py and baseline_reference.py, diagnose an observed limitation, check primary nearest work, and implement a feasible candidate. Write proposal.json containing study (matching study_schema), parent_trial (existing trial ID), and variants (1-4 objects with distinct name, file basename ending .py, role candidate/control, config object, and note). At least one candidate is required. Add key ablations or matched controls for the claimed mechanism when feasible; reference existing matched trials as controls where justified. Each variant is a standalone module. Do not run training. New architecture choices come from evidence; industry cards do not mandate them.

candidate_api.Model: Model(meta, config) -> torch.nn.Module; forward(batch) -> finite [B] logits
optional: literal CONFIG dictionary for model dimensions/lr

Model.diagnostics(batch) -> at most 64 named finite scalars; host calls this on the first 512 validation impressions at the frozen best checkpoint, under no_grad. These are candidate-supplied measurements, requiring source-level scrutiny and controls.
candidate_api.ownership: Edit or create only candidate model modules and proposal.json. No filesystem/network access from model code. Numeric imports only: torch,numpy,math,typing,copy,functools,collections,itertools,dataclasses,contextlib.
candidate_api.local_checks: Torch is not installed in the coding jail. Perform syntax/source checks there; host training and scoring follow automatically. Do not install packages or wait for human review.
candidate_api.training: from scratch; fixed host epochs, data, sample coverage, supplied history, scorer and seeds; optional optimizer/loss changes require explicit attribution controls
